name: threejs-shaders
title_zh: 不碰内置材质，直接写 GLSL 顶点与片元着色器
tagline_zh: 当内置材质调不出你要的扭曲、发光或顶点动画，直接上手 ShaderMaterial。不用翻文档拼凑。
tagline_en: When built-in materials can't twist, glow, or animate vertices the way you want, skip the doc-hunting. This skill.
desc_en: Three.js shaders - GLSL, ShaderMaterial, uniforms, custom effects. Use when creating custom visual effects, modifying vertices, writing fragment shaders, or extending built-in materials.
why_zh: 它不丢给你一段裸代码，而是按 Three.js 的渲染管线组织 vertex/fragment 结构。
why_en: Instead of dumping raw snippets, it structures vertex/fragment code around Three.js's pipeline and shows how to feed time.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 WebGL/WebGPU 的 GLSL 编写与 ShaderMaterial 接入；不涉及后处理 Effect。
limit_en: Covers only GLSL authoring and ShaderMaterial wiring for WebGL/WebGPU. No EffectComposer post-processing, no texture asset generation, no debugging.
title_en: Write GLSL vertex & fragment shaders directly, skip.
unshelf_reason: 2026-09-04 编辑判：three.js 动画/着色器/后处理四件，英文开发工具链（冷在读者身上）
